text:
maya (growth): Quick plan: 20min launch workshop next Tue. Offer: starter prompt pack + promo credits. Objective: measure lift in activation and time-to-first-success. Thoughts?
ryan (product): Keep demo narrow: template -> example output -> embed. One clear CTA.
lee (content): Drafting 2 prompt packs: 'Meeting notes' and 'Landing copy'. We should test which drives fastest first-success.
anya (ops): Will add signup param ?seed=launch_x to apply credits automatically. Need coupon id + expiry.
tess (analytics): Track events: credit_applied, prompt_installed, first_success. Metrics: activation rate, ttf_success, 7d token cost. Include utm and variant.
maya (growth): Variants: A = 3 credits + Meeting notes pack, B = 8 credits + Landing copy + onboarding email. Gate B to webinar RSVPs only.
anya (ops): Implement gate server-side: if params.seed=='launch_x' and user.new: apply_credits(800). Also prepare webhook for credit_applied -> onboarding email.deploy-bot: calendar event created: "Launch Workshop: Starter Pack" Tue 09:30-09:50
tess (analytics): Let's hold out 10% no-credit to measure baseline. Stratify by source.
lee (content): I'll add a 1-question survey: "Did you get a useful output within 3 tries?" for qualitative benchmark.
maya (growth): Action items: @lee drafts by EOD, @anya infra + coupon by Mon, @tess dashboard Wed AM, @ryan confirms demo flow. Reconvene Mon 11am. :thumbsup:
